note: Versioned pipeline registry (safe-versioning policy, docs/15). Select the active pipeline with ONE value (env PIPELINE_MODE overrides `active`), never by editing source. TERMINOLOGY IS BINDING (see `terminology`): "Higgsfield" = composite-v1 = production. "Legacy" = deprecated full-AI ring generation. composite-v1 is the DEFAULT and the production pipeline (user-locked 2026-07-16); legacy is kept intact but is NEVER used automatically and is never offered. On any shot the composite cannot produce faithfully (e.g. a worn angle unavailable from the 2D CAD), SKIP and request more source material (more CAD angles / a 3D model) - never let AI redraw the jewelry. Missing an image is preferable to a geometrically incorrect product.

policy.never_prompt_to_activate_legacy: Do not ask whether to activate legacy. Only act on an explicit user request naming Legacy.

composite-v1.description: DEFAULT (user-locked 2026-07-16). AI generates only the scene; the REAL source-CAD ring pixels are composited in - geometry identical to source by construction. Studio: always composite. Lifestyle/closeup: composite when the worn angle is achievable from source; else request more source or SKIP - never invent geometry.

legacy.description: DEPRECATED full-AI ring generation. Higgsfield renders the scene AND redraws the jewelry; geometry may drift (NO guarantee). Retained intact for manual experimentation ONLY - never production, never selected automatically, never a fallback. Activating it requires an explicit, unambiguous user request naming Legacy; a request for "Higgsfield" means composite-v1 and must NEVER be read as a request for legacy.

terminology.Higgsfield: ALWAYS means composite-v1, the production pipeline: Higgsfield generates ONLY the scene/background; the original source-CAD ring is composited in unchanged. Geometry identical by construction. This is what "generate with Higgsfield" means in this project.
terminology.Legacy: ALWAYS means the DEPRECATED full-AI ring generation pipeline, in which Higgsfield renders the scene AND redraws the jewelry. No geometry guarantee. Never production, never automatic.
terminology.note: Both versions route to the Higgsfield provider. The provider is NOT the distinction - the RING is. Naming the provider never implies legacy.
